name: Urea cycle citrulline-arginine synthesis with ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
rationale: All members concern urea-cycle synthesis of citrulline and arginine; the OTC deficiency variants are what this theme has that the other urea-cycle neighbours lack.

name: Genotoxin-induced DNA break response with NHEJ and poly-ADP-ribosylation
rationale: Members cover sensing and repair of DNA breaks, topology and fork stress after cisplatin, bleomycin, camptothecin and hydroxyurea; NHEJ and PARP ADP-ribosylation separate it from checkpoint-focused neighbours, and drug responses separate it from BRCA-centred ones.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling, cancer mutants and RUNX3
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signaling and its regulators; cancer-associated TGFBR/SMAD mutants and RUNX3 targets distinguish it from neighbours focused on ligand sequestration or RUNX3 alone.

name: Sarcoplasmic calcium release and extrusion dampening cardiac contraction
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-mediated calcium release and Na/Ca exchange-driven cytosolic calcium reduction in muscle; negative regulation of cardiac contraction, heart rate and relaxation distinguishes it from SERCA-reuptake and positive-inotropy neighbours.

name: Centrosome microtubule organization for spindle orientation and asymmetric division
rationale: Members concern centrosome positioning, microtubule nucleation and anchoring and cortical cues; spindle positioning and asymmetric division set it apart from centrosome-maturation, duplication and cytokinesis neighbours.

name: Osteoblast differentiation from mesenchymal progenitors via Wnt and mechanosignaling
rationale: Members regulate mesenchymal stem cell and osteoblast proliferation and differentiation (RUNX2, bone development); Wnt antagonism and PIEZO1/integrin mechanical-load signaling distinguish it from chondrocyte, osteoclast and collagen-matrix neighbours.

qualifier: reuptake, extrusion and ryanodine release control
name: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium reuptake, extrusion and ryanodine release control
rationale: Members control ER/SR calcium stores via ryanodine release (incl. caffeine), SERCA-type ATPase reuptake and Na/Ca exchange; SERCA reuptake and caffeine response distinguish it from release-only and cardiac-contraction neighbours.

core: Cardiomyocyte membrane domains and electrical coupling
name: Cardiomyocyte membrane domains, electrical coupling and integrin-ILK adhesion
rationale: Members concern cardiomyocyte sarcolemma organization (T-tubules, caveolae/rafts, gap junctions, cell adhesion, action potential); integrin and PINCH-ILK-parvin adhesion signaling distinguishes it from sarcomere-contraction neighbours.

name: Natural killer cytotoxicity regulated by KIR-MHC class I recognition
rationale: Members concern NK (and T cell) cytotoxic killing and its regulation; KIR cluster, MHC class Ib presentation and protection from NK killing distinguish it from neighbours centred on CD8 T cell proliferation.

name: Folate one-carbon metabolism and methionine salvage cycle
rationale: Members cover tetrahydrofolate/formate one-carbon metabolism feeding methionine, SAM and salvage (incl. MTRR, neural tube closure); combining folate with methionine salvage separates it from methionine-only and folate-only neighbours.

name: Wnt ligand secretion and non-canonical Wnt/calcium signaling
rationale: Members are Wnt/Ca2+ and WNT5A non-canonical signaling plus PORCN-dependent Wnt biogenesis and secretion; secretion distinguishes it from PCP and vascular neighbours, and the calcium branch from canonical ones.

core: Dendrite arborization and postsynaptic structural plasticity
name: Actin-driven filopodial dendrite branching and postsynaptic structural plasticity
rationale: Members regulate dendrite branching, spine morphology and postsynaptic actin/PSD structure; filopodium assembly and RHOF distinguish it from plasticity and EPHB neighbours.

name: Skin and sebaceous gland morphogenesis with epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members concern keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope and skin barrier establishment; epidermis morphogenesis and sebaceous gland development distinguish it from cornification and UV-response neighbours.

name: Base excision repair and direct reversal of alkylation damage
rationale: Members are glycosylase-initiated and long-patch base excision repair (incl. OGG1/MUTYH/NTHL1 defects) and ALKBH/MGMT alkylation reversal; direct reversal distinguishes it from glycosylase-recognition, mismatch and crosslink neighbours.

name: Tyrosine, proline and glycine amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are amino acid metabolic/catabolic terms; tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism distinguishes it from threonine neighbours and proline/glycine/glyoxylate from the phenylalanine neighbour.

name: Plasma membrane amino acid transport with Hartnup, SLC1A1, SLC6A14 defects
rationale: Members concern amino acid transport across the plasma membrane and its inherited defects; SLC1A1 and SLC6A14 variants and Hartnup disorder are what neighbours (iminoglycinuria, cystinuria, peptide transport) lack.

name: Ventricular trabecular myocardium formation and cardiomyocyte proliferation
rationale: All members concern ventricular trabeculation and cardiomyocyte proliferation/development; trabecular (not compact or atrial) myocardium and absence of endocardial/coronary terms distinguish it.

core: DNA methylation and facultative heterochromatin silencing
name: DNA methylation and facultative heterochromatin silencing, X inactivation, imprinting
rationale: Members concern DNA/PRC2 methylation-based facultative silencing (X inactivation, imprinting, CpG island methylation); this narrow silencing focus distinguishes it from neighbours spanning broad remodelers and histone acetylation.

name: Olfactory receptor-mediated odorant and pheromone perception
rationale: All members concern olfactory receptors and smell/pheromone responses, distinguishing it from taste-perception neighbours.

qualifier: RhoA/B/C and Cdc42 subfamily, formin activation
name: Rho and Cdc42 subfamily GTPase cycles and formin activation
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C, CDC42, RHOG/J/D GTPase cycles and formin effectors; RHOA-C and formins distinguish it from Rac- and RND/PAK/ROCK-centred neighbours.

core: Adenylate cyclase inhibition by Gi/Gz-coupled receptors
name: Gi/Gz-coupled adenylate cyclase inhibition via alpha-2 adrenergic receptors
rationale: Members concern GPCR inhibition of adenylate cyclase via Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenoceptors; the adrenergic receptor separates it from muscarinic/purinergic neighbours and the cyclase-level focus from secretion-outcome neighbours.

name: Heme-derived bilirubin clearance and inherited hyperbilirubinemias
rationale: Members cover heme degradation, hepatic organic-anion uptake, glucuronidation and export of bilirubin and their defects; heme catabolism and hyperbilirubinemia distinguish it from drug-ADME neighbours.

qualifier: bacterial attachment and host cell invasion
name: Epithelial bacterial attachment, invasion and Gram-positive mucosal defense
rationale: Members concern host-bacterium interaction at mucosal epithelium (attachment, entry, agglutination, metal sequestration, Gram-positive response); Listeria-type invasion and actin-based motility distinguish it from defensin, phagocyte and mycobacterial neighbours.

name: Fanconi anemia interstrand crosslink repair with replication checkpoint signaling
rationale: Members are Fanconi pathway ICL repair with FANCD2 monoubiquitination cycling, intra-S checkpoint and recombination resolution; Fanconi/monoubiquitination terms are what all neighbours lack.

name: Embryonic cartilage and joint morphogenesis via chondrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate chondrocyte proliferation, differentiation and hypertrophy, cartilage condensation and growth plate; joint morphogenesis and cartilage condensation distinguish it from ossification and articular-homeostasis neighbours.
